SNP density karyogram

Source: R/snp-density.R
snp_density.Rd

Visualize the distribution of genotyped or imputed variants across chromosomes. Two rendering styles are available: "heatmap" (default) bins variants and colors tiles by count, while "points" draws individual variant positions on chromosome outlines, where density is visible through natural clustering. Optionally marks centromere positions when centromeres are provided.

Usage

snp_density(
  data,
  chr = NULL,
  bp = NULL,
  p = NULL,
  style = c("heatmap", "points"),
  bin_size = 1e+06,
  color_by = c("density", "significance", "uniform"),
  seqinfo = NULL,
  centromeres = NULL,
  palette = "viridis",
  point_size = 0.3,
  point_alpha = 0.5,
  show_centromeres = TRUE,
  downsample_n = 2e+05,
  title = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A gwas_data object or data.frame with GWAS results.

chr, bp, p

Column name overrides.

style

Rendering style: "heatmap" for binned density tiles, or "points" for individual variant positions on chromosome outlines.

bin_size

Bin size in base pairs (default 1 Mb). Only used when style = "heatmap".

color_by

For style = "points": how to color dots. "density" (default) colors by local density, "significance" colors by -log10(p), or "uniform" for a single color.

seqinfo

Optional chromosome lengths as a Seqinfo object (GenomeInfoDb) or any object that has one, such as a TxDb, EnsDb or BSgenome. If NULL, chromosome lengths are inferred from the data.

centromeres

Optional centromere positions as a GenomicRanges::GRanges, one or more ranges per chromosome (for example the UCSC "Centromeres" track imported with rtracklayer).

palette

Color palette: "viridis", "magma", "inferno", or "plasma".

point_size

Point size for style = "points".

point_alpha

Point transparency for style = "points".

show_centromeres

If TRUE and centromeres are given, draw centromere markers.

downsample_n

Maximum number of points to plot in "points" style. Set to NULL to plot all variants (can be slow for >500k).

title

Plot title.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

data(example_gwas, package = "ggwas")

# Heatmap style (default); chromosome lengths taken from the data
snp_density(example_gwas, bin_size = 5e6)


# Different palette
snp_density(example_gwas, bin_size = 5e6, palette = "magma")


# Points style with centromere markers (hg38 positions for chr1 and chr2)
cen <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
  c("chr1:122026460-124932724", "chr2:92188146-94090557")
)
snp_density(example_gwas, style = "points", centromeres = cen)


# Points colored by significance
snp_density(example_gwas, style = "points", color_by = "significance")


# Full chromosome lengths from a Seqinfo, here taken from a TxDb
if (requireNamespace("TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene", quietly = TRUE)) {
  txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene::TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene
  snp_density(example_gwas, bin_size = 5e6,
    seqinfo = GenomeInfoDb::seqinfo(txdb))
}
